title: security: rbac v2 - enforce KMS region residency + audit hardening
author: Lina Park
description:
Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 policy enforcement for KMS-backed key usage so that (1) customer-managed KMS keys are only usable in allowed regions, (2) audit logs include KMS key id/region metadata for every sensitive operation, and (3) policy violations are enforced by default for new customers while an alerting window is available for existing customers. This change closes gaps found during a security review (ENG-2489) and addresses a compliance ask from a regulated customer (SUP-893).

What this PR does: implements KMS region residency checks in the RBAC v2 policy evaluator, augments audit logging to surface kms_key_id and kms_region on create/update/delete operations that touch encrypted assets, adds schema changes to the policy API (residency constraints), introduces a migration that backfills residency metadata for existing resources where available, and wires an opt-out feature flag for a 2-week grace period for some legacy accounts.

Checklist: - [x] Policy evaluator: enforce kms_region pinning when policy contains kms_residency constraints - [x] Audit logging: include kms_key_id and kms_region fields in structured logs (JSON) and in event index keys - [x] API: validation errors return explicit SUPPORTED_REGIONS list and error code - [x] Migration: idempotent migration to tag existing customer resources with discovered kms_region - [x] Tests: unit + integration + e2e for canary path - [x] Docs: API changelog and migration notes - [x] Rollout: feature flag and canary release plan included

Migration / Rollout plan: feature-flagged enforcement default disabled for existing customers for two weeks starting 2026-03-01, then auto-enabled. We run the migration in parallel during the grace window. Canary rollout to 10% of accounts for first 48 hours with increased audit sampling; metrics and alerting added to console (RBAC -> Compliance dashboard).

Testing: added unit tests for policy evaluator, integration tests that exercise KMS region mismatch failures, and e2e test that simulates a cross-region key usage and validates audit event content. CI showed an unrelated lint flake on first run (go vet on internal/infra) which was fixed in a follow-up commit and all checks passed on rerun.

References: Linear ENG-2489, SEC-501; Jira SUP-893; related PRs: pr-216789 (near-identical policy schema changes; dependency), pr-214812 (rbac v2 audit enhancements).
